question: How should the vital air be drawn in at the root of tongue and palate?
premises: The locus is the root of tongue and palate
The air is to be taken in
The action must be done slowly
inference: One should slowly drink in the air at the root of the tongue and palate.
uncertainties: kṛtvā may imply fixing attention or positioning before drinking the air
plain_english: Having focused at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
